name: menu-bar
title: Menu Bar Items
description: Every menu item of the app in front as one searchable list: File > Export > PDF with its shortcut; Enter presses it. macOS, over Accessibility.
author: pal

store.tagline: The front app's menus, searched and pressed from one list
features: Every menu item of the app in front, searchable from the root: `export pdf` finds Preview's item
Each row shows the item, the menus above it, its shortcut and a check mark when it is on
`enter` presses the item, so a dialog it opens lands in the app
Disabled items and separators are left out, and a slow app never delays the panel
macOS only; needs Accessibility, and the row opens the right settings pane when it is missing

screenshots.caption: The front app's menus in one list (TextEdit here): a section per menu, the path as the subtitle, shortcuts as key caps
A checked item carries its mark, and Enter Full Screen shows its Globe (fn) key
Typing narrows by the whole path: format font finds every item of Format > Font
The rows are root results too: export pdf at the root finds File > Export as PDF… with no palette opened first

actions.title: Press
actions.description: Hides the panel, then presses the item in the app.
